canonical_wall_definition: Exact symmetry is detectable, but no polynomially bounded, exactly composable semantic interface is yet known.

detection_wall.question: Can a genuine nontrivial exact symmetry witness S be detected and frozen?
detection_wall.note: UF150/UF250 candidate work supplies finite evidence that real exact exchangeability can be detected. This does not establish universal detection.

representation_wall.question: Given frozen (F,S), can one construct in polynomial time a polynomial-size exact interface representation for the induced existential boundary semantics?
representation_wall.formal_target: (F,S) -> Rep(R_C), where R_C(B_C) = { beta | exists X_C : F_C(X_C,beta)=1 }

composition_wall.question: Can many exact interface representations be composed without exponential product blowup while preserving exact joint semantics?
composition_wall.formal_target: Rep(R_C1),...,Rep(R_Cm) -> Rep(R_global) in polynomial total cost

mantequilla_operator.semantics: I is not a description of the symmetry itself; it is the minimally sufficient exact description of what the symmetric interior can communicate across its boundary.
obligations: F in SAT iff Q_I(F) in SAT_Q
joint boundary semantics must be preserved exactly
no hidden global search, full 2^n cube, or exponentially materialized quotient

exact_boundary_relation.warning: R_C must not be forced into an explicit truth table; doing so may manufacture an artificial representation wall.
exact_boundary_relation.permitted_representation_language_princi: Mantequilla may choose from a preregistered language family L, provided exact equivalence, polynomial representation size, and polynomial implementations of all required operations are proven or independently certified.
candidate_languages: BDD or other canonical decision representation
other preregistered exact symbolic interface language

central_question: Does detected exact symmetry induce a polynomially representable, polynomially composable exact boundary semantics?

information_firewall.freeze_boundary: After symmetry detection, seal F + S + permitted-local-view + hashes.
forbidden_after_freeze: SAT solver calls used to select or tune the bridge
global quotient enumeration as an implementation shortcut
detector-internal artifacts not included in sealed bundle

canonical_pipeline: RAW_INSTANCE -> DETECT -> FREEZE_S -> MANTEQUILLA -> EXACT_INTERFACE -> COMPOSE -> EXACT_CLOSURE -> CERTIFICATE -> RECONSTRUCT -> VERIFY

canonical_gates.objective: Construct a polynomial-size exact representation of R_C from frozen (F,S) and permitted local data.
Demonstrate exact equivalence, complete polynomial accounting, and an independently checkable certificate without hidden global search.
Compose several exact interfaces without reintroducing an exponential Cartesian product or equivalent hidden state explosion.
Lift an interface/quotient solution back to an original satisfying witness in polynomial time and verify it independently.
Only after the previous gates pass, test how far the mechanism extends beyond the discovery symmetry family.
canonical_gates.policy: Must use new preregistered untouched families; no general-SAT promotion from finite coverage.

discovery_specimen.scientific_question: Can the exact external semantics of the [40,240] symmetric interior be represented by a compact symbolic interface whose exactness and reconstruction can be verified without materializing 426,092,165 quotient states?

symmetry_coordinate_hint.idea: For a certified full symmetric action S_k on a cell C of k binary variables, assignments internal to C collapse by Hamming weight from 2^k raw assignments to at most k+1 assignment orbits.
symmetry_coordinate_hint.caution: Orbit weight alone is generally insufficient when external constraints induce correlations between members or between multiple cells.
symmetry_coordinate_hint.required_upgrade: The interface must encode the exact joint boundary relation, not independent per-variable admissible-value sets.
symmetry_coordinate_hint.future_test: Adversarial exact-symmetry instances with deliberately correlated external constraints are required after the local bridge passes.

candidate_subproblems.question: Can a compact generating set for the action on a detected cell certify the relevant exact symmetry group with polynomial verification cost?
Does there exist a preregistered representation language L in which the induced exact existential boundary relation stays polynomial-size and required operations stay polynomial?
When is orbit-coordinate compression semantically sufficient after coupling to the external boundary?
Can exact closure be performed symbolically without materializing the large quotient state space?
When do multiple compact local interfaces compose without an exponential product of interface states?

a_b_killer_test.control: Frozen old E3 / quotient route on the same already-detected symmetry witness.
a_b_killer_test.treatment: Mantequilla bridge with detector sealed off after FREEZE_S.
a_b_killer_test.success_criterion: A PASS requires exact semantics and polynomial symbolic accounting, not merely faster wall-clock execution.

adversarial_followup_policy.trigger: Only after a local/interface PASS and after UF250 reconciliation authority is settled.
adversarial_followup_policy.required_family: Fresh preregistered adversarial exact-symmetry specimens with external constraints engineered to create nontrivial joint correlations.
adversarial_followup_policy.prohibition: Do not use UF250 as confirmation for a mechanism conceived from UF250.
